# Brief 11: Product launch

Audience: Brightwell Health leadership team.
Decision: approve the launch of the Lumen sleep band at $149 with a $9.5M launch budget.
Format: 10 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds the direct online funnel and competitor prices used on slides 3 and 5.

## Facts

F1: The Lumen sleep band retails at $149 with a unit cost of $58, a gross margin of 61%.
F2: Competitor prices: Competitor A $199, Competitor B $129, Competitor C $169.
F3: Year-1 sales target is 120k units: direct 45%, retail 35%, partners 20%.
F4: Quarterly units in year 1 (thousand): Q1 18, Q2 27, Q3 33, Q4 42.
F5: Direct online funnel: 600k site visits, 240k product page views, 72k carts, 54k purchases.
F6: Launch budget is $9.5M: media 4.2, retail trade support 2.3, content and creators 1.5, public relations 0.6, contingency 0.9 (USD million).
F7: Break-even is reached at 78k units.
F8: Survey: 38% of target users rank sleep tracking among their top three wellness needs; 29% would pay $149 or more.
F9: Risk: a supplier delay of 8 weeks would cut Q1 units by about 40%.
F10: Launch plan: pre-order opens month 0, shipping month 2, retail from month 4, partner programmes month 6.
F11: Direct customers stay on subscription at 62% after six months in the pilot with 1,500 users.
